en: Sayuri giggled, sitting up and pulling the sheet over her shoulders. "Let him cook, Miyetsuko. I’m starving. Fujiwara-san, make me those eggs you do—the ones with the extra butter."
zh: 小百合轻笑出声，拉起被单裹住肩膀。“让他做吧，美悦子。我快饿扁了。藤原先生，做那个蛋吧——多加黄油的那种。”

en: Operating under covert aliases, the two girls distributed thousands of discount vouchers while exposing the guild's predatory surcharge scheme...
zh: 两人用假名掩护身份，在街头散发了数千张特惠折扣券，同时大肆揭发商会强征霸王附加税的丑恶行径……

en: She had traded her silver gown for a tactical suit of matte black, her skin pale against the shadows.
zh: 她换下了银色长裙，穿上了一身哑光黑的战术服，苍白的肌肤在阴影中格外显眼。

en: In that cramped, humid space, the "good girl" was long gone. There was only a girl who had mastered a dangerous lesson, and the boy who was now completely at her mercy.
zh: 在这狭窄潮湿的空间里，“乖女孩”早已荡然无存。只剩下一个掌握了危险功课的少女，以及那个此时此刻完全任她摆布的男孩。

en: "Command?" Fantasma laughed nervously. "Lady, you are brave. But this is my boat. These are my men."
zh: “指挥？”幽灵紧张地笑了。“女士，你很勇敢。但这可是我的船。这些人是我的手下。”

en: "And rank one..." Miyetsuko murmured, turning her gaze slowly toward Sayuri. "...by a catastrophic, statistical landslide."
zh: “而第一名……”美悦子喃喃自语，缓缓将视线转向了一旁的小百合，“……以绝对断层的统计学碾压优势夺冠。”

en: Inside "Fresh Mart," the atmosphere plummeted below freezing. Rin stared at her phone screen, her face turning pale with absolute, murderous rage before flushing deep crimson.
zh: 在“新鲜玛特”的店内，空气瞬间降至冰点以下。铃死死盯着手机屏幕，脸色由惊愕转为铁青，随后爆发出令人窒息的滔天怒火。

en: A splash of dried white residue, unmistakable and infuriatingly prominent, stained her skin and the silk of her nightgown.
zh: 那块风干后的白色残留物，清晰得令人发指，刺眼地烙印在她的肌肤和丝绸睡裙上。

en: Gunfire erupted, shattering the fog as an elite mercenary group closed in, expecting an easy kill.
zh: 枪声骤然撕裂浓雾，一支精锐雇佣兵部队迅速包围而来，他们原以为这会是一场轻松的猎杀。

en: Sayuri came out, looking angelic in a light sundress. She walked over and adjusted Fujiwara’s collar, her eyes soft with adoration. "I think you sound wonderful, darling. It’s festive. Happy Easter." She leaned in and kissed his cheek, oblivious to the fact that he looked completely ridiculous.
zh: 小百合走了出来，穿着一件轻盈的太阳裙，看起来像个天使。她走过去帮藤原整理了一下衣领，眼神里充满了爱慕。“我觉得很好听，亲爱的。很有节日气氛。复活节快乐。”她凑过去吻了吻他的脸颊，完全没意识到他现在的样子有多滑稽。
